info.name: qTest Manager API Version 3.0 Automation Job API

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The result is paginated. By the default, the number of objects in each page is 100 if this is omitted. You can specify your custom number (up to 999) in this parameter

params.name: page
params.description: By default the first page is returned but you can specify any page number to retrieve objects

items.docs: To search automation agents in projects that user is assigned to fields: specify which property of Automation Agent you want to include in the response. If you omit it or specify an asterisk (*), all of following fields are included: id, name, project_id, host_id, framework, active, configuration query: specify a structured query (criteria, operator and value) with one or multiple clauses to search for Automation Agents. Following are supporting criteria | Criteria | Opera
